prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Potassium (칼륨) itself — the sovereign of the Potassium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
An adult woman in her mid-twenties with warm beige skin, an elegant heart-shaped face, large emerald almond eyes, softly arched brows and a small confident closed-mouth smile. A short midface, gently rounded jaw and small soft chin. Ash-silver hair flaring into pale lilac at the tips, worn in a long high ponytail with two loose curved face-framing locks. A slender, full-busted, narrow-waisted build with rounded hips.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
A light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe. The signature potassium idea is a set of silver-white overlapping breastplate lamellae shaped like freshly shaved soft metal, opening into lilac flame-shaped layered robe panels at the hips; small leaf-green insets mark the pulse points. Deep neckline, bare shoulders and arms, high split panels exposing the thighs; intimate areas fully covered. No corset. Colours: lilac flame violet, ash grey, fresh-cut silver-white, sprouting leaf green. Both ordinary human hands empty and visible, five fingers each.

4. SCENE
World and pose: Standing on an old stone bridge above the rushing river that her clan never wades, in the ash forest highlands. Her weight rests on one leg, one open hand near her collarbone, the other relaxed beside her hip. Her face turns directly to the viewer. Burned woodland slopes sprout fresh green behind her; large iron potash pots and lilac hilltop flames in the distance.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (K) and atomic number (19) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, corset, bustle, Victorian tailoring, modern material, machinery.
acceptance: User chose 3,3,3 and authorized ordinary main publication.
